one_line: Anthropic went public in a record $81.3B IPO, while global data center investments are projected to reach $4 trillion by 2030.

themes.title: Anthropic completes record $81.3B IPO
themes.text: Anthropic completed a record-breaking $81.3 billion initial public offering, valuing the company at roughly $1.7 trillion while its founders cashed out $2 billion. Following the debut, Asian tech stocks plunged as the listing failed to halt a wider AI stock sell-off, and early investor Dustin Moskovitz reiterated calls for frontier labs to slow down.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B
Early Anthropic investor Dustin Moskovitz says labs should slow down
Asian tech stocks plunge as Anthropic IPO fails to stem AI sell-off

themes.title: Data center investments and space AI
themes.text: The International Energy Agency projected global data center investments to reach $4 trillion by 2030, noting that fewer than 100 major AI projects would require 50 gigawatts of power. Meanwhile, Google selected Blue Origin to launch its Project Suncatcher AI computing satellites in 2029.

stories.headline: IEA projects global data center investment to reach $4T by 2030
Google selects Blue Origin to launch Project Suncatcher AI satellites in 2029

themes.title: US chip approvals and export regulations
themes.text: The US Commerce Department approved sales of over 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, and the California AG subpoenaed Nvidia to investigate former CEO Jensen Huang's actions regarding China chip access. Additionally, Nscale may need a US license for ByteDance's GPU access under new export rules, and the Trump administration is considering requiring US firms to disclose Chinese AI use.

stories.headline: US Commerce Dept approved sales of over 879K AI chips to Chinese companies
California AG subpoenas Nvidia over former CEO Jensen Huang's affair
Nscale may need US license for ByteDance GPU access under new rules
Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose Chinese AI use

themes.title: Scientific models and AGI pathways
themes.text: Anthropic's Claude solved two open problems in black hole physics, including a calculation unresolved for over 20 years. Separately, research highlighted science agents conducting collaborative research and publishing papers, while Google DeepMind researchers outlined four pathways from AGI to ASI.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Claude model solves two open problems in black hole physics
Ethan Mollick highlights research on 35 human labs deploying science agents
Google DeepMind institute outlines four pathways from AGI to ASI
